### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only the one thing asked" (hand over the adjustment at once): excluded by the three Conditions sentences on the root's own hub plus the records showing no such lines; the "standing on the agreement" terms would read 0.00, giving a different protected repair cost.
- Using `approved_amount 0.0` or "the amount approved": excluded by the retired-clause notice in damage_disputes_9c7c4329.
- Old coverage rule (deductible plus repair above the coverage limit): excluded by the retired-clause notice in damage_protection_579442ab §2.
- Card-spend window including 2025-09-20 (would give 4890.00, still the 500.00 band): the window edge is stated ("3200.00 on 1 December 2025 … the first is 12 whole months before"); result unaffected either way.
- Deductible multipliers applied only to the 500.00 class part and the 2 % added afterwards (would give 347.65): excluded by the multiplier docs' object "The multiplier acts on the damage deductible", the deductible being what repair_size_deductible says it is "figured" as. Recorded as the nearest alternative; the visible wording points one way.
- Lost-accessory count 2 charged (120.00 × …): excluded by missing_accessory_count ("2 | first not charged | 1").
- Policy-side openness: none found.
